escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Asia this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, How the First Combat Submarine Actually Worked, by Denis Shmalts, with over 27 million views.
In second place, DIY Diwali decor 🪔, by Sharmi’s Creation, with over 30 million views.
And number one: गॉंव में दिवाली मनाने का तरीका🪔, by Thar Desert Photography, with over 72 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
